name: Lyapunov Fractal
desc: A Markus-Lyapunov 'Zircon Zity' fractal where the logistic map is driven by an alternating AB-sequence of two growth rates, its per-pixel Lyapunov exponent painting swooping biomorphic teal-and-gold ridges over a dark chaotic sea while the (a,b) window slowly pans, zooms, and re-strings section by section.

scale.doc: zoom into the (a,b) window (higher = deeper into the structure)

detail.doc: Lyapunov accumulation length (higher = sharper exponent, finer ridges)

x.doc: window center bias on growth-rate a

y.doc: window center bias on growth-rate b
